title: Duplicate charge after network blip
body: During the 2025-11-18 network incident some cards were charged twice. Root cause: the client retried with a fresh idempotency key.

title: Customers charged twice when card authorisation is retried
body:
Support ticket #48213 and 6 similar: when the gateway times out, the retry creates a second authorisation instead of reusing the first one. Customers see two holds and sometimes two captures.

Started after the retry policy change on 2026-03-01.

title: Duplicate idempotency keys in request logs
body: The structured logs show the same idempotency key on unrelated requests; probably a logging bug, not a functional one.

title: Duplicate invoice emails sent when the mailer retries
body: If the SMTP relay is slow, the dunning job retries and customers get the same invoice email twice. No double charges.

title: Pay button can be double-clicked on slow connections
body: The checkout button isn't disabled after the first click. The API rejects the second submit thanks to idempotency keys, but users see an error.
